text: Day 12, 19:15, forge cellar ward: Chadickith stood by the stair and looked slowly round the room at each of us. He said nothing. I folded the cloth in my hands and kept my eyes on Branda, because she is the one I cannot spare.

Day 13, 06:30, forge cellar ward: Chadickith asked me for the true number. I told him Branda tips within two days and the bleeding-off only slows the grey; I would not promise a number for anyone, myself included.
